topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecturer, welcomes the students, and outlines the scope of the lecture on inflammation.

topics.label: Innate Sensing of Infection and Damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms and receptor systems by which the innate immune system detects pathogens and cellular damage.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cascades and Leukocyte Recruitment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the cellular responses and downstream physiological effects triggered by inflammatory activation, including leukocyte trafficking and systemic complications.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the processes involved in terminating acute inflammation, repairing damaged tissue, and managing chronic inflammatory states.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture session and announces the topic of the next lecture.
